title: kate-core: open an editorconfig without blocking
summary: open_config_file opens .editorconfig with the non-blocking flag and then checks the handle. A FIFO returns None within two seconds. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add open_config_file and open_config_handle in modeline.rs. On Unix, open_config_handle uses OpenOptions read true and custom_flags. The Linux flag is 0x800. Every other Unix flag is 0x4. On a non-Unix host, open_config_handle uses File::open. open_config_file opens the handle, then reads file.metadata. It returns None when the open fails, the metadata fails, the handle is not a file, or the length is greater than MAX_EDITORCONFIG_BYTES. push_layer calls open_config_file and drops the path metadata check and the path File::open. read_capped stays as it is and still reads the opened handle. Add open_config_file to the test import list. open_config_file_returns_a_small_file writes root = true and a newline, opens that path, and reads the same text through read_capped. The oversized body returns None. A directory path returns None. a_fifo_config_open_returns_none creates a fifo with mkfifo, calls open_config_file on a worker thread, and waits at most two seconds. The result is None. Add no crate dependency. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep this change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: modeline::tests::open_config_file_returns_a_small_file
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because open_config_file does not exist. A small file returns the text root = true and a newline. An oversized body returns None. A directory returns None.

regression_tests.name: modeline::tests::a_fifo_config_open_returns_none
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because open_config_file does not exist. A fifo returns None within two seconds. The worker uses recv_timeout of two seconds.
